main_claim.statement: For independent cap-one original coordinates and arbitrary ambient symmetric A, any nonsingular original-coordinate principal 3x3 block B gives ||p_Q||_infinity <= 128*2^(1/4)*|det B|^(-1/3), uniformly in all outside couplings and affine terms.
main_claim.scope: supporting branch; does not assert the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis forces a determinant lower bound

mechanism: Two-case physical-block decomposition. Large diagonal: scalar square plus rank-two affine half-Riesz. Small diagonals: determinant forces a quantitatively indefinite physical pair; pair-log smoothing plus exact scalar Schur small-ball closes the branch.

partner_result_applied.use: Pure off-diagonal determinant-scale theorem; the new theorem resolves its proposed near-zero-diagonal stability step in an all-diagonal form.

structural_counterexample: For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), s_3(A_m)=1 but max over physical principal triples of |det| equals m^-2. Thus no universal one-triple determinant threshold follows from the spectral hypothesis.
first_unpaid_implication: Prove a dimension-free aggregate-before-inversion reduction that combines the determinant physical-triple branch with ridge/diffuse/grouped-coordinate mechanisms when every useful fixed physical triple determinant is small; selecting the best single triple is invalidated by the block-bank family.
continuity_status: OPEN; only essential boundedness is asserted in the proved branch
